notes.title: Nautical Survival is coming to early access! 🦈
notes.content:
https://store.steampowered.com/app/2860990/Nautical_Survival/

AHOY, MATEYS!
NAUTICAL SURVIVAL is my upcoming survivor-like auto-shooter set in a vast, unforgiving ocean. Command a heavily armed vessel, navigate through treacherous waters, and fend off relentless hordes of sea monsters. Upgrade your seacraft, equip it with weapons and hire crew members to your aid.​

FEATURES

 High replayability and unlockable content
 A variety of possible builds and playstyles
 Action-packed naval experience
TRY OUT THE DEMO AND DROP ME A WISHLIST, WONCHA?
Why Wishlist?

 Get notified on launch day
 Be the first to try out new updates and features
 Support the development of the game!

Thank you,
Idan

notes.title: God Save the Queen!
